name: Qu Mei Home Furnishings Group Co.,Ltd
summary: Qu Mei Home Furnishings Group Co.,Ltd., headquartered in Beijing, China, specializes in the creation, production, and distribution of residential furniture across the nation. The company's diverse product portfolio includes various indoor furnishings such as upholstered items, beds, dining sets, home storage solutions, and entertainment units, all retailed through its network of showrooms. Established in 1987, the firm adopted its present name in June 2015, having previously operated as Qumei Furniture Group Co., Ltd.
